prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” interior painting company for everyone — the best choice depends on your location in St. Louis, your budget, how big the job is, the finish and paint brands you want, and your timeline. I can help you pick the best one for your needs. First, a few quick tips and a checklist so you can identify top local painters, plus an offer to find a shortlist if you give your zip code.

What makes a top interior painter
- Strong local reputation: 4.5+ stars on Google/Yelp with many recent reviews.
- Verified references and a portfolio of similar jobs (interior rooms, trim, ceilings).
- Proper insurance (general liability + workers’ comp) and any required local licensing.
- Clear, written estimate detailing prep, number of coats, paint brand & sheen, and timeline.
- Warranty or touch-up policy (at least 1 year for workmanship).
- Good communication and a written contract (start/end dates, payment schedule, clean-up).
- Uses quality paints (Benjamin Moore, Sherwin-Williams, etc.) and does full prep (patching, sanding, priming where needed).

How to compare estimates
Ask each painter to provide a written estimate that includes:
- Scope: rooms, ceilings, trim, doors
- Surface prep details: patching, sanding, caulking, primer use
- Number of coats and paint brand/type (low-VOC if desired)
- Labor vs. materials cost
- Start date and estimated completion
- Cleanup and disposal policy
- Payment schedule and warranty

Red flags
- Very lowball bids with no details
- No proof of insurance or unwillingness to provide it
- Pressuring you to sign immediately or large upfront payment (>30%)
- No written contract or vague scope

Where to look for top St. Louis painters
- Google Maps and Yelp (read recent reviews)
- Angi/HomeAdvisor and Houzz
- Better Business Bureau (look for complaints/resolution)
- Local Facebook groups / Nextdoor for neighborhood referrals
- Ask friends/neighbors for referrals and to see completed work in person

If you want, I can:
- Find the top-rated interior painters near your zip code and give you a shortlist (3–5) with ratings and contact info
- Draft a short email or script to request estimates and sample questions to ask on the phone
- Help compare 2–3 estimates if you paste them here

Tell me your zip code, whether this is a single room or the whole house, any brand or VOC preferences, and your target start date and budget, and I’ll build a tailored shortlist.
